entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: small-business card lending, deposits and loans are ordinary serving activities with no named enabling program.

notes: The Item 7 excerpts are fragmentary. E3's footnote ($2.1 billion related to entities providing capital to low-income and rural communities) appears in an unidentified table that also reports related interest expense, so its nature (investment vs. consolidated funding) is unclear. The glossary defines Investor Entities as those investing in CDEs that 'provide debt financing to businesses and non-profit entities in low-income and rural communities' and mentions a Community Benefits Plan (CBP) without detail. This was treated as the same activity as E3 and not counted separately. It was not credited as an Entrepreneurship 'enabling' program or a Cross-cultural 'customer access' activity because no named program, reach or description is given; when torn, the lower level was chosen. A human reviewer may wish to check the full MD&A tables. Educational assistance and competitive parental leave benefits are mentioned but are generic. 'Community Reinvestment Act', 'Government & Education' table row, and 'foundation' (risk framework) mentions were treated as traps or non-activities. The planned Brex acquisition (agreement signed January 22, 2026) is a planned activity and was not scored.
